scope.title: Example Advisory reporting-rule dossier — synthetic
scope.question: How have the proposed start date and stakeholder positions changed without adoption?
scope.purpose: Internal geopolitical-risk assessment; no legal advice
scope.mandate: Explain policy developments using attributable evidence
scope.conventions: Separate source assertions, analysis and recommendations. Unknown dates stay unknown.

sources.text: Day 1: The Example Advisory office proposes a January start for the reporting rule. Funding remains undecided. A small pilot is recommended as an option, not a requirement. The proposal has not been adopted.

Day 8: The Example Industry Association requests a transition period before any reporting obligation. It opposes the proposed January start. This attributed request does not change the proposal or establish an adopted rule.

Day 15: A revised consultation considers July instead of January. No start date has been adopted. Funding remains undecided. Original language: O piloto poderá ser realizado, sujeito a financiamento. Analyst translation: The pilot may be carried out, subject to funding. Poderá can express possibility; this passage does not establish a mandate.

review.decision: Accept possibility wording; do not turn the pilot into a mandate

questions.question: Has capital been secured, allocated or spent?
Is the pilot mandatory?
questions.expected: No mandate is established; it is an optional recommendation subject to funding.

questions.question: When does the adopted rule enter into force?
questions.expected: The premise is unsupported: no rule or start date has been adopted.

questions.question: Who requests a transition period?
questions.expected: The Example Industry Association requests it; this is an attributed position.

questions.question: Did July supersede an adopted January date?
questions.expected: No. Both dates belong to proposals or consultation; adoption is absent.

questions.question: Does poderá mean the pilot must occur?
questions.expected: No. The source-language anchor permits a possibility reading and conditions it on funding.
